Job Description: About the Job We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Installation Engineer to independently execute and oversee complex server and network deployments supporting enterprise physical security systems. In this mid-level role, you will take ownership of installation projects, configure advanced infrastructure components, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure seamless integration between servers, network equipment, and security endpoints. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including physical security installers and sustaining operations, while mentoring junior engineers. This position demands strong technical expertise in Dell server platforms and Cisco networking, along with the ability to provide 24x7 support in a globally distributed environment. Key Responsibilities Lead hardware provisioning activities, including advanced RAID configuration and disk array optimization, to meet performance and redundancy requirements for high-write-volume security applications such as video storage systems. Configure and validate Integrated Dell Remote Access Controller (iDRAC) and Lifecycle Controller settings, ensuring firmware baselines are established using Dell OpenManage before OS deployment. Independently deploy operating systems via PXE boot automation or iDRAC Virtual Media methods, including Windows Server and hardened Linux distributions, ensuring compliance with corporate standards. Design and implement network segmentation strategies using VLANs and dedicated subnets to isolate physical security traffic (CCTV, PIDS, Intercom) from management networks. Configure Quality of Service (QoS) policies on Cisco Catalyst switches to prioritize high-bandwidth video streams, ensuring low latency and minimal packet loss for live monitoring and retention systems. Manage Power over Ethernet (PoE/PoE+) budgeting and monitoring on access layer switches, ensuring reliable power delivery to IP cameras, door readers, and security panels. Implement network device hardening best practices on Cisco IOS devices, including Access Control Lists (ACLs), disabling unnecessary services, and securing management protocols (SSH/HTTPS). Coordinate with network engineers and physical security installation teams to validate network readiness, port activations, and successful device-to-server communication paths. Execute comprehensive validation testing, including bandwidth saturation tests, physical layer distance checks, and latency measurements, before operational handoff to sustainment teams. Develop detailed documentation, including logical and physical topology diagrams, VLAN matrices, IP assignment records, and configuration backups. Provide 24x7 technical support for all in-scope infrastructure systems, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions for medium-complexity issues. Deliver weekly project status updates and maintain programming sheet validations, as-built documentation, and asset management system accuracy throughout the deployment lifecycle. Required Skills Related field experience with 6+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise server and network infrastructure deployment. Strong expertise in Dell PowerEdge server platforms, including RAID controllers (PERC), iDRAC configuration, firmware management, and Lifecycle Controller operations. Proficient in Cisco networking technologies, including Catalyst switches, VLAN configuration, QoS implementation, PoE management, and IOS security hardening. Solid experience with Windows Server and Linux operating system deployment, administration, and troubleshooting in enterprise environments. Working knowledge of scripting languages (Python, PowerShell) and automation tools for configuration management and deployment acceleration. Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical teams and provide mentorship to junior engineers while working in 24x7 rotational support models. Tools Required Server & Hardware Tools: Dell iDRAC, Lifecycle Controller, Open Manage, and RAID/PERC utilities for server provisioning, firmware baselining, and remote management. OS Deployment Tools: PXE boot infrastructure, iDRAC Virtual Media, Windows Server & Linux ISOs with hardening and automation scripts. Network Tools: Cisco IOS CLI, PoE management, VLAN/QoS configuration tools, network monitoring, and bandwidth/latency testing utilities. Automation & Operations Tools: Ansible, Python, CMDB systems, configuration backup tools, and documentation/diagramming platforms for global 24x7 operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:  Astreya is placing a Software Asset Manager to lead a ServiceNow SAM Pro program at one of our key clients, a global financial services and investment research firm. This is a program leadership position rather than a platform administration role.   The successful candidate will own the program charter, manage stakeholder relationships, handle publisher compliance positions, and build a sustainable governance model. You will act as the client-facing program lead across four distinct phases, partnering closely with our client's internal teams and Astreya's SW Data Analyst based in Mumbai.   Phase-by-Phase Responsibilities Phase 0: Assessment Sprint (Days 1–30):  Lead a 14-point assessment covering discovery tool stacks, CMDB health, and system integrations. Present the report to our client's IT leadership within 30 days. Phase 1: Foundation (Days 31–120):  Define the multi-source discovery architecture across Windows, MacOS, and agentless surfaces. Oversee the loading of entitlement records for Tier 1 publishers like Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe, IBM, and SAP. Integrate entitlement record creation into the procurement workflow to ensure every software PO generates a record within 24 hours. Phase 2: Operationalize (Days 121–210):  Produce the first Effective License Position (ELP) for all Tier 1 publishers by Day 130. Design and implement a reclamation workflow and lead a license downgrade optimization program to document savings. Deliver SAM training, build out knowledge base articles, and publish the signed SAM Program Charter. Phase 3: Managed Operations (Day 211 Onwards):  Own the monthly ELP refresh cycle and distribute compliance reports to leadership. Manage publisher relationships and lead audit responses when triggered by Tier 1 publishers. Facilitate operations and business reviews to present OKR progress, YTD savings, and audit readiness scores.   Core Duties Own the SAM program charter, scope, and governance model across all implementation phases. Manage cross-functional relationships across Finance, Procurement, IT, Security, and HR. Escalate and manage data quality issues that block ELP accuracy through to resolution. Monitor Publisher Pack release notes monthly to flag licensing model changes. Support software vendor contract negotiations utilizing SAM data as the primary evidence source. Own the renewal pipeline by surfacing upcoming renewals 90, 180, and 365 days in advance.   Required Qualifications (Non-Negotiable) Program Rollout Experience:  Candidates must possess hands-on program rollout experience; individuals who have only operated a steady-state mature program will not meet the bar for this engagement. Experience Level:  Minimum 5 years of experience in a Software Asset Management role. Implementation Leadership:  At least 2 years directly delivering or leading a ServiceNow SAM Pro implementation from Phase 0 to first ELP publication. Discovery Architecture:  Demonstrated experience designing multi-source discovery architecture across at least two endpoint management platforms. Entitlement Loading:  Hands-on experience loading entitlement records from purchase order data for at least three Tier 1 publishers. ELP Production:  Proven experience producing and validating an ELP for Microsoft, along with at least one of Oracle or Adobe. Workflow Integration:  Experience running reclamation workflows and integrating SAM Pro into ITSM onboarding or offboarding workflows. Licensing Knowledge:  Deep understanding of licensing models for Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe, IBM, and Apple VPP. Platform Proficiency:  Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Pro, ServiceNow ITSM, Microsoft Intune/SCCM, Jamf Pro, and ServiceNow Integration Hub.   Preferred Qualifications ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in Software Asset Management. Experience with endpoint intelligence tools like Tanium Asset and Performance or Nexthink. Experience utilizing SaaS License Management in ServiceNow, including Okta integration. Prior experience in a client-embedded program lead role at a managed services provider or consultancy. Familiarity with VDI environments (Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop) and their impact on Microsoft and Oracle license counting.   Key Success Outcomes Day 30:  Deliver the SAM Readiness Report with all Phase 0 discovery questions answered and OKRs baselined. Year 1:  Achieve a SAM program ROI above 3:1, maintain zero unresolved Tier 1 publisher shortfalls, and hit an audit readiness score above 90% for all Tier 1 publishers. Job Overview The Incident Response Analyst is a key member of the Incident Response Center (IRC), responsible for 24/7 monitoring, first-level analysis, triage, and escalation of alerts related to data center infrastructure and services. This role ensures continuous health, availability, and security of data center operations by monitoring critical systems, detecting events, assessing impact, and coordinating with cross-functional teams for timely resolution. The Analyst provides real-time situational awareness across data center facilities, network and server systems, environmental controls, cloud infrastructure, and external risk factors.   Key Responsibilities Monitor alarms and alerts across data center infrastructure, including network and server devices, hardware health indicators (disk usage, temperature, etc.), WAN circuits, local connectivity, and facility environmental systems such as temperature, humidity, power, racks, and PDUs. Monitor Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), cloud dashboards, and relevant monitoring tools for system health and service availability. Assess external risks such as natural events (floods, earthquakes, fires, severe weather) that may impact data center operations. Monitor and review CCTV activity for security events within data center facilities. Validate, investigate, and analyze alerts to determine impact and urgency. Create, update, and manage incident tickets using Jira or similar ITSM platforms. Escalate incidents promptly to cross-functional teams including Network, Compute, Storage, Facilities, Security, and Cloud teams. Communicate incident updates and notifications using tools such as Everbridge and email. Prepare Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs), document timelines, and maintain accurate incident records and handover notes. Review and track vendor emails regarding planned maintenance, emergency changes, and service advisories. Maintain documentation including SOPs, process updates, and knowledge base articles. Utilize DCIM systems, monitoring tools, CCTV platforms, and communication systems to support daily operations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2–5 years of experience in a data center operations center, NOC/SOC, monitoring environment, or incident management role. Basic understanding of network fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, WAN/LAN concepts) and server or hardware components (CPU, memory, storage). Ability to interpret system alerts, analyze issues, and perform initial triage. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work independently, meet goals, and maintain attention to detail. Demonstrated ability to interact effectively at all levels within the organization, including with clients, while being a collaborative team player. Ability to work in 24/7 rotating shifts as required. Preferred Qualifications Experience in a Data Center, NOC, SOC, or similar operations command center environment. Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Everbridge, DCIM systems, monitoring platforms (SolarWinds, Nagios, Grafana, etc.), and CCTV monitoring tools. Experience writing incident reports or post-incident reviews. Exposure to cloud platforms such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, AWS, Azure, or GCP. Knowledge of ITIL processes, especially Incident, Problem, and Change Management. Strong situational awareness and ability to manage multiple priorities during critical events. Effective collaboration skills when working with cross-functional support teams.

Job Description Incident Response Center (Analyst)  Job Title  – IRC Analyst Summary The IRC (Incident Response Center) is the first layer of defense responsible for quick detection and incident response using various monitoring and automation tools, conducting thorough investigation of alerts, classification, and triage. The IRC Analyst is responsible for delivering operations within the IRC across all client data center sites globally. IRC analysts are expected to respond to all alarms/alerts set in the data center environment, including Infrastructure Management (DCIM), Server Automation Operations System (SAOS), CCTV, Access Control Systems (ACS), and Building Management Systems (BMS), providing deep understanding and intelligence of the criticality and impact of incidents to resolver groups. Responsibilities  Incident & Problem Management Analysts are responsible for the full lifecycle of incident management, from detection through to resolution and root cause analysis (RCA). This includes acting as incident commanders, maintaining SLAs, documenting actions, and providing insights to support continuous improvement efforts across teams and systems. Investigate, report, and respond to alerts, incident response (war room, remote bridges). Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, and conduct in-depth investigation of alerts. Be the first line of defense using monitoring and automation tools to conduct investigation, classification, and triage, all within prescribed SLAs. Provide deep understanding and intelligence of incident criticality and impact to resolver groups. As an End User Support IT Specialist, you will provide on-site and remote technical support for internal end-user software, hardware, and connectivity.
